skills.name: Bullet Time
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Fortune's Favor
skills.description: Chance to deal critical damage on attack.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Shadow Heart
skills.description: Increases your Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Sommersault Kick
skills.description: A devastating kick that accompanies a backward somersault. Attacks all enemies in the vicinity. Cannot be used when equipped with a gun.

skills.name: Double Shot
skills.description: Fire consecutive shots that split on impact and explode on nearby enemies. Can only be used when equipped with a gun.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description:
Use by double-tapping, and then holding, Left or Right. Increases Speed, Jump, and Knockback Resistance for the dash's duration.
Not affected by buff duration increase effects. Can also be used in the air.
[Dash Activation: Right-Right or Left-Left]
Right-click to lock the command.

skills.name: Pirate Leap
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump even farther. The higher the skill, the farther the jumping distance. Can also be used with the jump key.

skills.name: Gun Mastery
skills.description: Increases Gun Mastery, Critical Rate, and Number of Bullets.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training. Also reduces damage.

skills.name: Agile Guns
skills.description: Increases Gun Attack Speed and Dexterity.

skills.name: Infinity Blast
skills.description: Allows you to use attack skills without consuming bullets, and increases your Attack Power.\nThe first bullet in your inventory will be used to calculate your damage. Not usable if there are no bullets in your inventory.

skills.name: Rapid Blast
skills.description: Blast enemies with super speed.

skills.name: Wings
skills.description: Allows you to jump longer and further.
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Recoil Shot
skills.description: Harness your gun's recoil to retreat upon firing.

skills.name: Wings
skills.description: Fire downward, using the recoil to blast off from the ground. (If used in the air, the jump distance decreases and can only be used once.) If you used Wings to jump from the ground, you cannot do so again in the air.\nPress and hold the skill key again, while jumping with Wings, to glide and descend slowly. Let go to fall at normal speed.

skills.name: Scurvy Summons
skills.description: Summon a brave crewman from the Nautilus. The summoned crewman will move around freely and fire homing bullets at the enemy. This skill is unaffected by enemy damage reflection skills. The crewman targets the enemy with the highest max HP within range.

skills.name: Swift Fire
skills.description: Fire three consecutive shots at the enemy.

skills.name: Cross Cut Blast
skills.description: Marks your Ammo, making them more powerful.

skills.name: Outlaw's Code
skills.description: Strict adherence to the Outlaw's Code provides a permanent increase to Status Resistance, Elemental Resistance, Defense, Knockback Resistance, and Max HP/MP.

skills.name: Fullmetal Jacket
skills.description: Coat your bullets with iron, granting increased Final Damage, Critical Rate, and Ignore Defense.

skills.name: All Aboard
skills.description: Summon two crew members to assist you in battle. If you are targeted by a fatal status effect, a crew member will block it. The crew members target the enemy with the highest max HP within range.

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice cooldown will be reduced.

skills.name: Blunderbuster
skills.description: Fires a powerful gun that damages multiple enemies.

skills.name: Blackboot Bill
skills.description: Summons the mighty Blackboot Bill to blast through enemies and knock them back. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Siege Bomber
skills.description: Set up a stationary cannon to temporarily bombard nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Targets the enemy with the highest max HP within range.

skills.description: Summons two random crew members to assist you in battle. If you are targeted by a fatal status effect, a crew member will block it.

skills.name: Escape Shot
skills.description: Escape from a dangerous situation in a spray of gunpowder.

skills.name: Aggressive Stance
skills.description: Take the offensive to obtain a damage increase buff every time your attack skill hits. Also, permanently reduces damage taken.

skills.name: Double Down
skills.description: Try your luck! Roll two dice, and if both have the same number, you'll receive a very powerful buff.

skills.name: Ahoy Mateys
skills.description: Pump up the crewmen from your All Aboard skill with your amazing leadership, making them more powerful. Uses the Corsair's majestic demeanor to increase Max HP and Critical Damage. Separate additional passive effects are given when crewmen are summoned. If you learn the Ahoy Mateys skill, you can use Broadside.

skills.name: Majestic Presence
skills.description: Uses the Corsair's majestic demeanor to increase Gun Mastery, Attack Power, and Final Damage, and use explosive bullets to deal additional damage.

skills.name: Quickdraw
skills.description: Your attacks have a chance to greatly increase the damage of your next Brain Scrambler, Ugly Bomb, Nautilus Strike, or Target Lock.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Rapid Fire
skills.description: Fires a hail of energy bolts. Hold down the skill key to keep shooting. You can move left and right while attacking.

skills.name: Tempest Bombardment
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Nautilus Strike
skills.description: Order the Nautilus to attack multiple enemies at once. The Nautilus is unaffected by attack reflection.\nUses the captain's majestic demeanor to increase Final Damage of Majestic Presence.

skills.name: Parrotargetting
skills.description: Hit the enemy with a special shot that leaves a mark for targeting. Prioritizes bosses within range. From then on, all attacks will be focused on that enemy. Also permanently increases Final Damage and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Brain Scrambler
skills.description: Shoots the target in its squishy bits to deal heavy damage to it.

skills.name: Eight-Legs Easton
skills.description: Fire a hefty barrage of bullets. If a Corsair uses this skill while pressing the down arrow key, its attack range will be reduced, but the Corsair will be immune to knockback while casting.

skills.name: Jolly Roger
skills.description: Your pirate pride kicks in, boosting Attack Power, Status Resistance, and Elemental Resistance, but lowering Avoidability. Also increases Knockback Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Broadside
skills.description: Summons the Nautilus. The battleship's cannon attack is unaffected by attack reflection.\nSP is not required for this skill, and it can be used if you learn the Ahoy Mateys skill.

skills.name: Eight-Legs Easton

skills.name: Tempest Bombardment
skills.description: The Nautilus unleashes an overwhelming bombardment. Tempest Bombardment cannot be used at the same time as Siege Bomber or Broadside. Bombards one of the enemies hit by your attacks, prioritizing the enemy affected by Parrotargetting. If there are no Parrotargetting enemies, the skill prioritizes the boss with the highest Max HP.\nCan be toggled On/Off.\nSP is not required for this skill, and it can be used if you learn the Ahoy Mateys skill.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Whaler's Potion
skills.description: Enhances the Corsair's mighty body with the captain's spirit, temporarily enhances your summons and bombardment, and increases your summons' Attack Speed.\nUnaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Double Down - Saving Grace
skills.description: Grants a chance to ignore the cooldown when Double Down does not activate. The next time, you will activate a Double Down with 4 or above.

skills.name: Double Down - Addition
skills.description: Adds the lucky number 7 to Double Down.

skills.name: Double Down - Enhance
skills.description: Increases the chances of rolling a 4, 5, or 6 in Roll of the Dice.

skills.name: Brain Scrambler - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Brain Scrambler's damage.

skills.name: Brain Scrambler - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Brain Scrambler.

skills.name: Brain Scrambler - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Brain Scrambler.

skills.name: Rapid Fire - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Rapid Fire damage.

skills.name: Rapid Fire - Add Range
skills.description: Increases Rapid Fire range.

skills.name: Rapid Fire - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Rapid Fire.

skills.name: Loaded Dice
skills.description: The next time you use Roll of the Dice, you get to throw an extra die and choose your desired number (via the number keys). Jobs without Roll of the Dice will be allowed to use the Roll of the Dice skill and choose their desired number.
skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Loaded Dice).

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice's cooldown will be reduced by 50%.
skills.note: V-matrix Roll of the Dice; Corsair also has Roll of the Dice as a 2nd-job skill (5211007).

skills.name: Bullet Barrage
skills.description: Wildly fire your gun in all directions. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill. Reuse the skill to immediately cancel it. While using Bullet Barrage, you cannot glide with Wings or use Wings in the air.
skills.note: Bullet Barrage.

skills.name: Target Lock
skills.description: Locks onto your targets, then draws your gun and fires upon them in rapid succession. Aims at the boss with the highest Max HP within a certain range. If you're already aimed at the max number of enemies that can be attacked, and a high priority enemy appears within range, the aim on the farthest enemy is released and the high priority enemy is aimed onto. Invincible while casting.
skills.note: Target Lock.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.description: Puts your weapon into overdrive to unleash more attack power. Afterwards, your weapon will be less effective for a short while and cannot be unequipped until it's back to normal.
skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Overdrive).

skills.name: Nautilus Assault
skills.description: The Battleship Nautilus charges forward at its enemies. Strike enemies with the ship to create a weak spot, then fire all cannons to annihilate them. Unaffected by attack reflection.\nCannot be used when Nautilus Strike is being used.
skills.note: Nautilus Assault (main entry).

skills.name: Death Trigger
skills.description:
Fire a volley of penetrating, pinpoint-accurate shots. If there are still enemies in range after the initial volley, your shots will ricochet toward them.\nIf there is only one enemy to attack, then after attacking that enemy, the shots will ricochet and attack again.
\nIf there's an enemy with Parrotargetting applied, the whole volley will target that enemy first, then attack them again during the ricochet. Ricocheting shots are unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: Death Trigger (main entry).

skills.name: Death Trigger
skills.note: Death Trigger (variant).
